decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (8091-P01 B and 02B received 16/04/2010 and 8091-P01 C and P02 C received 18/01/2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be use by customers or staff for the cooking or preperation of food outside the following times [0800-1900].

Condition : 4 - Within one month of the date of this permission a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house 1 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobin shall be identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area. The lids of the Eurobins shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.

Condition : 5 - The parking space shown on the approved drawings shall be permanently retained and kept available for vehicle parking unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The kitchen extract system shown on the approved drawings, when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:(a)	A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the site.(b)	The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one meter above eaves level or one meter above openable windows of nearby properties.(c)	The ducting shall be circular.(d)	The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.(e)	The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.(f)	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.(g)	The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
description: Continued use of building (325b) to the rear of the shop for food preparation and cooking
